verdict.rationale: Better Auth maintains an official Auth0 migration guide with a migration script. The guide covers email/password with proper hashing, social accounts, 2FA, and best-effort organization migration. A configurable password hashing function implies existing hashes can be carried over, but the evidence never explicitly states that users avoid password resets. missing for 10: explicit documentation that imported users keep their passwords without a reset, migration guides or tooling for other competing providers (Clerk, Cognito, Firebase, Supabase, etc.), independent or hands-on corroboration of a no-reset migration from a hosted provider.

support.subject: As a founder, I can follow vendor-maintained migration guides or tooling for moving off a competing auth provider without forcing password resets

citations.quote: we'll walk through the steps to migrate a project from Auth0 to Better Auth including email/password with proper hashing, social/external accounts, two-factor authentication, and more.
the script will also attempt a best-effort migration of Auth0 Organizations, their members, and per-member roles.
You can customize the password hashing function by setting the `password` option in the configuration.
